notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Essence Flux.
description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
